turnaround_reason: CHTR collapsed from ~$286 to ~$156 (down ~45%) on accelerating broadband subscriber losses (172k lost in Q2 2026) as fixed-wireless and fiber overbuilders eat into cable. The bull case is a deleveraging, buyback-heavy FCF machine that just closed the $34.5B Cox merger, adding scale, mobile growth, and $800M of targeted synergies.
bullish_points: Cluster of open-market insider buying: net +1.58M shares over 6m, including CEO Winfrey and multiple directors buying $170-175/share in April — insiders stepping in above the current price
Cox merger (closed Aug 2026) creates the largest U.S. broadband/video provider (~37M customers, 45 states) with synergies raised to ~$800M
Mobile is the growth engine — ~12M lines and climbing — partially offsetting cable erosion; video losses moderating
Prodigious free cash flow funds continued buybacks at a depressed multiple; +18.6% over the last 30 days suggests a base is forming
Profitable (9% net margin) with 55% gross margins — this is a cash-generative operating business, not a broken one
bearish_points: Extreme leverage: enterprise value ~$120B against a ~$21B market cap (debt/equity ~442) — equity is a thin, highly-levered claim, so subscriber trends dominate the stock
Secular broadband decline is the core problem and it is accelerating, not stabilizing (120k lost Q1, 172k lost Q2)
Merger integration risk on top of a declining base; synergy realization is multi-year and not guaranteed
Fixed wireless and fiber competition shows no sign of easing
catalyst: Broadband net-add trend inflecting (losses narrowing) plus visible Cox synergy capture and continued aggressive buybacks shrinking the share count
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings (late October 2026); Cox synergy milestones through 2027
suggested_trade: Small starter spot in the mid-$150s alongside the insider-buying cluster; size modestly given the leverage. Prefer common over options — the high debt makes the equity volatile and the thesis is a multi-quarter deleveraging story.
key_risk: Broadband subscriber losses keep accelerating, so the deleveraging math breaks and the levered equity re-rates sharply lower
would_skip_if: Q3 broadband losses exceed Q2's 172k or FCF/buyback pace slows, signaling the deleveraging thesis is failing
